name: file_read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem. Supports text files with optional line range selection for large files.

manual.overview: Use file_read to inspect source code, configuration files, logs, or any text file. It is the primary way to understand what is in a file before editing it.

examples.output: Full file contents with line numbers

examples.description: Read lines 50-70 of a large log

tips: Always read a file before editing it to understand its current state.
For large files (>500 lines), use offset and limit to read sections instead of the whole file.
Check file existence before reading to avoid errors.
edge_cases: Binary files will return garbled output — use this only for text files.
If offset exceeds the file length, an empty result is returned.
Extremely large files (>10MB) may be slow; use limit to cap output.
